heading: EXT. ROPE BRIDGE OVER GORGE - DAY

units.text: EXT. ROPE BRIDGE OVER GORGE - DAY
A plank bridge slung across a mile-wide chasm in the Andes.
Wind howls.
Clouds drift below, bone white.
The planks are gray and gapped.
At the middle, four hikers stand frozen on the sagging span, packs on their backs.
JOSEPHINE "JOJO" TAN, thirties, leads, one hand on the rope rail.
EMEKA OBI, forties, a doctor, follows.
DARIUS WHITTAKER, twenties, a photographer, clutches a camera case to his chest.
SOLVEIG ENGSTROM, sixties, a retired geologist, brings up the rear, step by careful step.
Everyone stay on the center line.
units.name: JOJO

units.text: There is no center line, Jojo.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: Then pretend.
units.name: JOJO

units.text: Wind slaps the bridge.
The whole span lurches.
Emeka grips the rail.
Darius shrieks.
Solveig plants her trekking poles and stands like a tree.
Don't look down, don't look down, don't look down.
units.name: SOLVEIG

units.text: Solveig, can you keep moving?
units.name: EMEKA

units.text: I can keep moving. I choose not to.
units.name: SOLVEIG

units.text: A plank cracks and drops away into the cloud.
Jojo leaps over the gap and lands badly.
Darius lunges after her, Emeka catches his pack strap, and for a moment all three are a tangle at the edge of a missing board, the camera case swinging wild.
Hold! Hold!
units.name: JOJO

units.text: I'm holding!
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: You're holding the camera!
units.name: EMEKA

units.text: Darius looks down at his own hand, clamped on the case, and his other hand, empty, flailing.
He drops the case.
It tumbles, small and square, into the white.
He grabs the rope.
That was ten years of work.
units.name: DARIUS

units.text: We cross now. Single file. Quickly.
units.name: SOLVEIG

units.text: Agreed.
units.name: JOJO

units.text: They move.
The bridge sways like a hammock.
Jojo steps across the gap first, then Emeka, then Darius, who is weeping silently, then Solveig, steady as a metronome, until they all stand together on solid rock on the far side.
Nobody speaks.
Solveig lowers herself onto a boulder.
Jojo laughs, once, a short astonished sound.
Emeka puts a hand on Darius's shoulder, and Darius, finally, nods.
